anzsic_codes.name: Soft Drink, Cordial and Syrup Manufacturing

merger_description:
The proposed acquisition concerns the establishment by Platinum Equity, LLC (**Platinum Equity**) and Nestlé S.A. (**Nestlé**) of a 50:50 joint venture in the Nestlé Waters business.

On 23 July 2026, Forward I S.à r.l. (owned and controlled by investment entities that are directly or indirectly managed and/or advised (including through intermediaries and funds) by Platinum Equity Advisors, LLC and ultimately controlled by Platinum Equity) and Nestlé, entered into a Put Option Agreement. Pursuant to the Put Option Agreement, which includes a Sale and Purchase Agreement in agreed form (**SPA**), the Forward I S.à r.l. has irrevocably committed to acquire from Nestlé 50% of the issued share capital and voting rights of WPB JVco S.à r.l., a special purpose vehicle incorporated to hold Nestlé Waters, with Nestlé retaining the remaining 50% (the **Acquisition**).

Platinum Equity is a US-headquartered global private equity and investment strategies firm. The Platinum Equity Group specialises in the merger, acquisition and operation of companies providing services and solutions to customers in a broad range of sectors including, business services, information technology, telecommunications, logistics, metal services, manufacturing and distribution.

Nestlé is a Swiss company headquartered in Vevey, Switzerland, and publicly listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (ticker: NESN). Nestlé is primarily involved in the production, marketing, and sale of a large variety of food and beverage products.

The Nestlé Waters business offers waters, comprising still, sparkling and flavoured water, as well as non-alcoholic beverages, including flavoured sparkling beverages. Its international brands (S.Pellegrino, Acqua Panna, the SanPellegrino Italian Sparkling Drinks, and Sanbitter range) are sold in Australia through third-party distributors.

WPB JVco S.à r.l. is a special purpose vehicle established solely for the Acquisition to hold Nestlé Waters. It does not itself supply goods or services in any industry.

events.title: Notification waiver determination published

determination_table_content.details:
In making this notification waiver determination, the Australian
Competition and Consumer Commission (the ACCC) has considered
the information provided with the notification waiver application and
had regard to the factors in section 51ABV(2)(b) of the Competition
and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act).
Based on the information provided in the application, the ACCC
considers that the Acquisition is unlikely to give rise to any material
lessening of competition given:
a. there is no horizontal overlap between Platinum Equity (and
its connected entities) and Nestlé Waters in the supply of
non-alcoholic beverages in Australia
b. there is a low risk of foreclosure or other concerning vertical
effects resulting from exclusionary conduct post-acquisition.
In these circumstances, the ACCC does not consider it necessary to
reach a concluded view on the likelihood of the notification
thresholds being met.
Given that material competition concerns are unlikely to arise, the
ACCC has determined that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.
The ACCC considers that the determination is consistent with the
object of the Act and the interests of consumers in promoting
competition.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notification waiver applications and to assessing competition
effects more generally, see the ACCC’s guidance on notification
waivers and merger assessment guidelines.
